slides.texte_overlay:
green flags you're becoming
smarter without noticing

you notice patterns

you start seeing the same patterns in history, people and nature. connecting things across different fields is one of the clearest signs of a growing mind.

you enjoy hard questions

questions without easy answers now excite you more than they annoy you. curiosity about difficult things is exactly how real, deep understanding begins.

you read the whole thing

you finish the long article instead of just reading the headline. patience with long, complex ideas is a quiet but very powerful kind of intelligence.

you crave new lessons

you look forward to 5 minutes of learning more than 5 minutes of scrolling: a planet, a painting, a moment in history. that shift says everything about where your mind is going.
slides.texte_sophia:
you crave new lessons

i look forward to my 5 minute lesson more than scrolling now: a planet, a painting. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and that shift says everything.

slides.texte_overlay:
you change your mind

you can say i was wrong without feeling small. updating your opinions when you learn something new is the real and lasting mark of a smart, growing mind.
